title: Ikimazi c'umutima ukunze
intro: Mu gihe c’ibigeragezo vy’Imana, umutima warahamagariwe igikorwa c’iherezo co kuyoboka. Uwo mubare yakuriye mu gihugu c’ubugaragwa, yarakuze kugira ngo agire ukwizera n’ukwihangana. Igihe iyerekwa ryategeka ko batanga ikimazi, ntibahungabana. Inkuru yabo ni ibuye ry’imfuruka ry’ukwihebera Imana.
clues: Nari inyishu y’isengesho ry’umuhanuzi akomeye ryari ritegerejwe kuva kera.
Jewe na mawe twasigaye mu kiyaya c’amatongo, dufise gusa ivyo kurya vy’amata n’amazi.
Narakuze mba umuhanuzi azwi ko ari umunyakuri kandi yihangana.
Nafashije dawe gushinga imishinge y’inzu nyeranda yeguriwe Allah.
Dawe amaze kumbwira indoto yo kuntanga ikimazi, naramwishuye nti: 'Kora uko wategetswe.'
Allah yarateye iteka ukuyoboka kwanje mu kurungika impfizi y’intama ivuye mw’ijuru kugira ngo incungure.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Ukwiyorosha n'umutima ukunze kugira ngo umuntu atangwe .
trial.answer: Ukwiyorosha n'umutima ukunze kugira ngo umuntu atangwe .

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
